svg.text: euvd/history.jsonl: the connections, source addresses and trend flag this monitor records for every entry each day, because the EUVD keeps no history. Each entry's
level is the median of its own connections on the previous recorded days.

g.text: EUVD-2024-22282 Check Point Check Point Securi

svg.text: One row per entry that reached five times its own level from ten or more addresses, or was in a surge, on any of the last 29 recorded days (129
entries; the 20 with the most such days are shown). One column per day. The colour is that day's connections against the entry's level (the median
of its previous recorded days), pale around the usual level and dark at 20 times and more; a dot marks the UPTICK flag. 2 entries were at that level
on three recorded days in a row, the persistent surges this monitor reports.
Limits: Starts with the monitor's record on 7 October 2026; a cell stays blank until the entry has four earlier recorded days to form a level. A missing column is a day
the monitor did not run. Until 13 October this chart compared connections with the EUVD's 30-day average, which is on another scale and overstated every ratio.
UPTICK compares one day with the 7-day average (inferred from the data, not documented), so one flag alone is a one-day burst.
